what.text: This page follows people displaced inside Liberia, counted by IDMC and by UNHCR, shown side by side and never added together.
IDMC's year-end figure for people living in internal displacement because of conflict and violence stayed at 23000 from 2009 to 2014.
UNHCR's last figure for internally displaced people in Liberia is 237822, for 2005.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Liberia in 2003, with LURD and MODEL, at war level.
Floods are the disasters recorded for Liberia in IDMC's data.

when.text: The main years of displacement in the data are 2009 to 2014.
IDMC also recorded 22059 new displacements from disasters during 2024, a count of movements, not people.

how.text: The sources don't say where displaced people are living or which routes they took.
IDMC's new displacements count each forced move, so someone forced to move twice is counted twice.
